test: vacuity demonstration -- the stall rule switched OFF
why: The stall rule is the loop's central claim: a turn that consumes no new measurement is decoration. Asserting that is cheap. This runs all 10 turns with IMPROVER_ALLOW_VACUOUS=1, hashes each turn's plan, and counts the distinct values. If the rule were merely a convenience the plans would differ; they do not.
verdict: every track produced exactly ONE distinct plan across ten turns. Turns 2-10 are byte-identical re-derivations of turn 1, which is what the stall rule refuses to print. The loop stops at the turn after the last measurement, and that turn number is the finding.
